title: Cherrypicking DNA and Pooling with CSV Input
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Prepare CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a .csv file that includes the header line and the columns: Sample number, Plate number, Source well, Destination well, Start Concentration (ug/uL) Source, Final Concentration (ug/ml) Destination, Sample volume (uL), Diluent Volume (ul), Total Volume (ul) Destination. Ensure Plate number values are only 1, 2, or 3 (the protocol supports up to three source plates).

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the number of source plates to be used (1‑3) and specify the mount (left or right) for the Opentrons P20 Single‑Channel pipette.

steps.title: Transfer diluent
steps.instruction: Using a single P20 tip, aspirate the Diluent Volume indicated for each well in the CSV and dispense it into the corresponding Destination well of the final plate.

steps.title: Transfer DNA and mix
steps.instruction: For each CSV entry, aspirate the Sample volume of DNA from the Source well (from up to three source plates), add it to the well that already contains the transferred diluent, mix the combined solution in that well, dispense it into the Destination well of the final plate, and perform a post‑dispense mix.

steps.title: Pool samples
steps.instruction: Aspirate 5 µL from each completed sample well and dispense all aliquots into well H12 of the final plate to create the pooled sample.
